_readme: Every dashboard and insight in the AECi PostHog observability plane, as data. apply.sh
is a thin applier over this file; it invents nothing.
Shapes verified live against project 354071 on 2026-08-24: dashboard-create,
insight-create (DataVisualizationNode + HogQLQuery), and every query below compiled and
executed. They return ZERO ROWS today because the AECI-642 transport has not shipped —
that is expected, not a defect. See README.md §"What is verified and what is not".
- Board insights may return any number of rows.
- ALERT-SOURCE insights (dashboard "AECi — Alert signal sources") MUST be an aggregate
with NO GROUP BY, so they always return exactly one row. A query that can return zero
rows gives its alert nothing to evaluate.

dashboards.name: AECi — Traffic (SSR + API)
dashboards.description: Ported from observability/datadog/dashboard.json (Phase 2, AECI-66). Worker-side request volume, latency and error rate for both Workers. NOTE (WC-8 / AECI-322): under native Workers Cache a HIT skips the SSR Worker entirely, so cache_status is MISS / non_cacheable only — there is no hit series, and these are MISS / Worker-run volume. Edge HIT rate lives on the Cloudflare Workers dashboard.

dashboards.name: AECi — Search (Algolia + browser)
dashboards.description: Ported from observability/datadog/dashboard-search.json (Phase 3, AECI-141/140/174/266). Algolia sync health, index drift, the orphan sweep, and browser search telemetry. The two browser widgets were sourced from the retiring Datadog RUM aeci.search.query action and now read the consent-gated search_performed event instead (spec §3.9) — a deliberate narrowing from all searches to the consented slice.

dashboards.name: AECi — Home / Stats
dashboards.description: Ported from observability/datadog/dashboard-home-stats.json (Phase 4, AECI-180). The two silent-failure surfaces behind the home page: the daily home-stats compute cron and the deferred page_views write.

dashboards.name: AECi — Auth / Reviews / Moderation
dashboards.description: Ported from observability/datadog/dashboard-auth-reviews.json (Phase 5, AECI-206). Sign-ins (emitted by the SSR Worker at /auth/callback, so service=aeci-web not aeci-api), review submits, moderation actions, toxicity scoring, and the daily moderation-queue gauges.

dashboards.name: AECi — Requests / Linear pipeline
dashboards.description: Ported from observability/datadog/dashboard-requests-moderation.json (Phase 6, AECI-219). The request→Linear pipeline: issue creation, the site→Linear resolution push, inbound webhooks, and the every-15-minute reconciliation sweep.

dashboards.name: AECi — Cron health & retention
dashboards.description: NEW — no Datadog board equivalent; cron health lived only in monitors. Carries (a) the in-product mirror of the external liveness sweep, (b) the per-job failure roll-up, and (c) the two non-paging Datadog monitors the spec §5 table routes to 'digest': 'Retention prune skipped (metrics_daily gap)' and 'Data quality check found WARN-severity issues'. Both keep their old thresholds in observability/posthog/README.md.

dashboards.name: AECi — Alert signal sources
dashboards.description: One insight per PostHog alert. Every alert must be attached to an insight, and every one of these returns EXACTLY ONE ROW by construction (an aggregate with no GROUP BY), so a healthy-but-empty window evaluates to 0 rather than to 'no rows' — which is the shape that makes a threshold alert safe. Reading this board top to bottom tells you what every alert currently sees. Do not add breakdowns here; use the topic boards for that.

insights.name: AECi — Traffic — SSR render volume and latency by route class
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Top routes by request count (SSR route_class)' + 'Page render duration per route_class — p50/p95/p99'. p50/p99 are not reconstructed: the OTLP explicit-bucket histogram gives an exact bucket-upper-bound percentile, and one (p95, the one that carried a monitor) is enough here.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard.json widgets 1 + 3.
-- `count` is the OTLP histogram observation count, `value` the sum of observations,
-- so mean = sum(value)/sum(count). p95 is the upper bound of the bucket the 95th
-- observation falls in — see the 'AECi — ALERT' insight of the same shape for the
-- guard rails (overflow sentinel + minimum sample).
SELECT
    m.attributes.route_class                                          AS route_class,
    lower(m.attributes.cache_status)                                  AS cache_status,
    toInt(sum(m.count))                                               AS renders,
    round(sum(m.value) / greatest(sum(m.count), 1), 1)                AS mean_ms
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.page.render.duration_ms'
GROUP BY route_class, cache_status
ORDER BY renders DESC

insights.name: AECi — Traffic — SSR render latency distribution (histogram buckets)
insights.description: The exact latency shape, with no percentile reconstruction at all: observation counts per explicit OTLP bucket. This is the widget to trust while PostHog Metrics is still alpha — it is a straight read of what the transport sent.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. No Datadog equivalent — Datadog's distribution type hid the buckets.
-- Bucket bounds are pinned by the transport (spec §2):
--   [5,10,25,50,75,100,250,500,750,1000,1500,2500,5000,7500,10000] ms
-- `histogram_counts` has bounds.length + 1 entries; the last is the +Inf overflow bucket,
-- rendered below as the string '>10000'.
WITH agg AS (
    SELECT
        sumForEach(m.histogram_counts) AS counts,
        any(m.histogram_bounds)        AS bounds
    FROM posthog.metrics AS m
    WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
      AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.page.render.duration_ms'
)
SELECT
    arrayJoin(
        arrayZip(
            arrayMap(i -> if(i > length(bounds), '>10000', concat('<=', toString(bounds[i]))),
                     arrayEnumerate(counts)),
            counts
        )
    ) AS bucket_and_count
FROM agg

insights.name: AECi — Traffic — API query volume and p95 by endpoint
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'p95 API query duration per endpoint'. Tagged by MATCHED ROUTE PATTERN (e.g. /api/products/:slug), never the concrete path — the §3.5 cardinality rule. Note AECI-563: on /api/promote this now times only the fast kick-off; the ingest is aeci.api.promote.job.duration_ms.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard.json widget 4.
WITH per_endpoint AS (
    SELECT
        m.attributes.endpoint          AS endpoint,
        sumForEach(m.histogram_counts) AS counts,
        any(m.histogram_bounds)        AS bounds
    FROM posthog.metrics AS m
    WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
      AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.api.query.duration_ms'
    GROUP BY endpoint
)
SELECT
    endpoint,
    toInt(arraySum(counts)) AS requests,
    arrayPushBack(bounds, 999999.0)[
        greatest(indexOf(arrayMap(c -> c >= 0.95 * arraySum(counts), arrayCumSum(counts)), 1), 1)
    ] AS p95_bucket_upper_ms
FROM per_endpoint
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 40

insights.name: AECi — Traffic — 4xx / 5xx rate per hour, both Workers
insights.description: Datadog parity: '4xx / 5xx error rate over time (both Workers)'. Same numerator/denominator as the 'Worker error rate' alert, but broken out per hour so you can see the shape rather than the single number the alert evaluates.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard.json widget 5.
-- lower() on status_class is defensive, not cosmetic: Datadog lowercased tag values on
-- ingest and PostHog does not, so any casing assumption carried over from the Datadog
-- queries is a silent-zero waiting to happen. See README.md §'Migration hazards'.
SELECT
    toStartOfHour(m.timestamp)                                                   AS hour,
    toInt(sum(m.count))                                                          AS requests,
    round(100.0 * sumIf(m.count, lower(m.attributes.status_class) = '4xx')
          / greatest(sum(m.count), 1), 3)                                        AS rate_4xx_pct,
    round(100.0 * sumIf(m.count, lower(m.attributes.status_class) = '5xx')
          / greatest(sum(m.count), 1), 3)                                        AS rate_5xx_pct
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND m.metric_name IN ('aeci.page.render.duration_ms', 'aeci.api.query.duration_ms')
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour DESC
LIMIT 200

insights.name: AECi — Traffic — cache purges by source and outcome
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Cache purge events by source'. Extended with `outcome` because the WC-5/WC-6 split gave the consumer its own failure vocabulary (purge_failed / no_cache / noop) that the Datadog widget could not see.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard.json widget 6.
SELECT
    m.attributes.source  AS source,
    m.attributes.outcome AS outcome,
    m.attributes.mode    AS mode,
    toInt(sum(m.value))  AS purges
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.cache.purge'
GROUP BY source, outcome, mode
ORDER BY purges DESC

insights.name: AECi — Search — Algolia sync runs by outcome, entity and trigger
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Algolia sync runs by outcome' + 'by entity and trigger', merged — HogQL returns all three dimensions in one table where Datadog needed two widgets.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-search.json widgets 1 + 2.
SELECT
    m.attributes.trigger AS trigger,
    m.attributes.entity  AS entity,
    m.attributes.outcome AS outcome,
    toInt(sum(m.value))  AS runs
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.algolia.sync'
GROUP BY trigger, entity, outcome
ORDER BY runs DESC

insights.name: AECi — Search — Algolia sync duration and records pushed
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Sync duration — p50/p95/p99 (by trigger)' + 'Records pushed per entity (saved/deleted)'. aeci.algolia.sync.records submits the RECORD COUNT as its value, not 1 — so it is summed, not counted.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-search.json widgets 3 + 4.
SELECT 'duration'                                                    AS section,
       m.attributes.trigger                                          AS dimension_a,
       ''                                                            AS dimension_b,
       toInt(sum(m.count))                                           AS runs,
       round(sum(m.value) / greatest(sum(m.count), 1), 1)            AS mean_ms_or_records
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.algolia.sync.duration_ms'
GROUP BY dimension_a
UNION ALL
SELECT 'records'                                                     AS section,
       m.attributes.entity                                           AS dimension_a,
       m.attributes.op                                               AS dimension_b,
       0                                                             AS runs,
       sum(m.value)                                                  AS mean_ms_or_records
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.algolia.sync.records'
GROUP BY dimension_a, dimension_b
ORDER BY section, dimension_a, dimension_b

insights.name: AECi — Search — Algolia index drift and orphan sweep per index
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Index drift per index (AECI-140)'. Also carries the REPORT-ONLY value half of the dual Datadog monitor 'AECi — Algolia index drift (D1 ≠ Algolia)' (threshold: abs(drift) > 0 over 1d) — spec §5 routes the value half here and the liveness half to the CI sweep.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-search.json widget 5,
-- plus the AECI-266 orphan-sweep gauges the Datadog board never showed.
SELECT
    m.metric_name              AS metric,
    m.attributes.index         AS index_name,
    m.attributes.entity        AS entity,
    argMax(m.value, m.timestamp) AS latest_value,
    max(m.timestamp)           AS last_seen
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND m.metric_name IN (
      'aeci.algolia.index_drift',
      'aeci.algolia.orphans_removed',
      'aeci.algolia.orphans_skipped_cap')
GROUP BY metric, index_name, entity
ORDER BY metric, index_name

insights.name: AECi — Search — browser query latency by result bucket (consented slice)
insights.description: RE-HOMED (spec §3.9). Datadog source: 'Search query latency — p50/p95/p99 (browser RUM, AECI-174)'. Two accepted narrowings: the RUM action saw every search, this sees only the consented slice; and the action carried `index` while search_performed does not, so the per-index split is lost. Grouped by results_bucket instead. Full note in observability/posthog/README.md.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-search.json widget 6.
-- Reads the PRODUCT-ANALYTICS event, not a metric — hence `events`, not posthog.metrics.
-- `status` / `duration_ms` / `results_bucket` are already on the searchPerformed()
-- signature (apps/web/src/app/analytics/analytics.ts); `index` is NOT, so the RUM
-- action's per-index split does not survive the re-home. Until prod carries these
-- properties the columns read null and this is empty rather than wrong — PostHog's
-- taxonomy warning on `duration_ms` is the expected pre-AW2 state.
SELECT
    properties.results_bucket                                                 AS results_bucket,
    count()                                                                   AS queries,
    round(avg(toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.duration_ms))), 1)            AS mean_ms,
    round(quantile(0.95)(toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.duration_ms))), 1) AS p95_ms
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND event = 'search_performed'
GROUP BY results_bucket
ORDER BY queries DESC

insights.name: AECi — Search — browser query error rate (consented slice)
insights.description: RE-HOMED (spec §3.9). Datadog source: 'Search query error rate (%) (browser RUM, AECI-174)'. The Datadog widget had to restrict the denominator to @context.index:(products OR federated) because one successful /search query emitted TWO ok actions while a failure emitted ONE — the event carries one row per query, so that correction is no longer needed.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-search.json widget 7.
-- The Datadog widget had to restrict its denominator to @context.index:(products OR
-- federated) because ONE successful /search query emitted TWO ok RUM actions (one per
-- index) while a failure emitted ONE federated error — counting all actions halved the
-- apparent error rate. search_performed is one row per query, so that correction is
-- gone along with the `index` dimension that made it necessary.
SELECT
    toStartOfDay(timestamp) AS day,
    count()                 AS queries,
    round(100.0 * countIf(toString(properties.status) = 'error') / greatest(count(), 1), 2) AS error_rate_pct
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND event = 'search_performed'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 60

insights.name: AECi — Home stats — compute runs by outcome and duration
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Stats compute runs by outcome' + 'Stats compute duration — p50/p95/p99'.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-home-stats.json widgets 1 + 2.
SELECT
    m.attributes.trigger AS trigger,
    m.attributes.outcome AS outcome,
    toInt(sum(m.value))  AS runs
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.stats.compute'
GROUP BY trigger, outcome
ORDER BY runs DESC

insights.name: AECi — Home stats — per-key outcome (which key failed)
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Per-key compute outcome (which key failed)' + 'Per-key compute duration — p95 (by key)'. Per-key is best-effort: one key failing does not abort the rest, which is exactly why the per-key breakdown exists.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-home-stats.json widgets 3 + 4.
SELECT
    m.attributes.key     AS stats_cache_key,
    m.attributes.outcome AS outcome,
    toInt(sum(m.value))  AS runs
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.stats.compute.key'
GROUP BY stats_cache_key, outcome
ORDER BY stats_cache_key, outcome

insights.name: AECi — Page views — writes by outcome and bot class
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Page-view writes by outcome'. Extended with the AECI-526 `bot` tag so the human/bot ratio is readable here rather than only in the daily digest — prod page_views has historically been ~89% bot.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-home-stats.json widget 5.
SELECT
    toStartOfDay(m.timestamp) AS day,
    m.attributes.outcome      AS outcome,
    m.attributes.bot          AS bot,
    toInt(sum(m.value))       AS writes
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.pageviews.write'
GROUP BY day, outcome, bot
ORDER BY day DESC, writes DESC
LIMIT 200

insights.name: AECi — Page views — write error rate per hour (%)
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Page-view write error rate (%)'. Same numerator/denominator as the page_views alert, per hour.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-home-stats.json widget 6.
SELECT
    toStartOfHour(m.timestamp) AS hour,
    toInt(sum(m.value))        AS writes,
    round(100.0 * sumIf(m.value, m.attributes.outcome = 'failed')
          / greatest(sum(m.value), 1), 2) AS error_rate_pct
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.pageviews.write'
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour DESC
LIMIT 200

insights.name: AECi — Auth — sign-ins by method and outcome
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Sign-ins by outcome' + 'Sign-ins by method', merged. Emitted from the SSR Worker at /auth/callback, so these rows carry service=aeci-web, NOT aeci-api. 'Attempts' = the sum over outcomes (one per sign-in COMPLETION); browser-side initiation is not counted.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-auth-reviews.json widgets 1 + 2.
SELECT
    m.attributes.method  AS method,
    m.attributes.outcome AS outcome,
    m.attributes.reason  AS failure_reason,
    toInt(sum(m.value))  AS signins
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.auth.signin'
GROUP BY method, outcome, failure_reason
ORDER BY signins DESC

insights.name: AECi — Auth — sign-in failure rate per hour (%)
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Auth failure rate (%)'. Per hour, so the alert's single hourly number can be read in context.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-auth-reviews.json widget 3.
SELECT
    toStartOfHour(m.timestamp) AS hour,
    toInt(sum(m.value))        AS attempts,
    round(100.0 * sumIf(m.value, m.attributes.outcome = 'failed')
          / greatest(sum(m.value), 1), 1) AS failure_rate_pct
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.auth.signin'
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour DESC
LIMIT 200

insights.name: AECi — Reviews — submits by outcome
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Review submits by outcome'. outcome ∈ ok / duplicate / product_not_found.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-auth-reviews.json widget 4.
SELECT
    toStartOfDay(m.timestamp) AS day,
    m.attributes.outcome      AS outcome,
    toInt(sum(m.value))       AS submits
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.review.submit'
GROUP BY day, outcome
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 200

insights.name: AECi — Moderation — actions, bans and request moderation
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Moderation actions by action / outcome'. Extended with aeci.moderation.ban (AECI-218/524, with the AECI-524 role tag) and aeci.request.moderation.action (AECI-216) — both shipped after the Datadog board was exported and were never added to it.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-auth-reviews.json widget 5.
SELECT
    m.metric_name        AS metric,
    m.attributes.action  AS action,
    m.attributes.role    AS role,
    m.attributes.outcome AS outcome,
    toInt(sum(m.value))  AS actions
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND m.metric_name IN (
      'aeci.moderation.action',
      'aeci.moderation.ban',
      'aeci.request.moderation.action')
GROUP BY metric, action, role, outcome
ORDER BY metric, actions DESC

insights.name: AECi — Toxicity — scoring volume, error rate and latency
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Toxicity scoring latency — p50/p95/p99' + 'Toxicity scoring error rate (%)', merged. Backed by Claude Haiku since AECI-258 (Perspective API sunset).
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-auth-reviews.json widgets 6 + 7.
SELECT
    toStartOfDay(m.timestamp) AS day,
    toInt(sum(m.value))       AS calls,
    round(100.0 * sumIf(m.value, m.attributes.outcome = 'failed')
          / greatest(sum(m.value), 1), 1) AS error_rate_pct,
    arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(toString(m.attributes.reason),
                                       m.attributes.outcome = 'failed'), ', ') AS failure_reasons
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.toxicity.api'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 100

insights.name: AECi — Moderation — queue depth and oldest pending age
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Moderation queue — oldest pending age (h) + depth'. Also carries the BACKLOG half of the dual Datadog monitor 'AECi — Moderation queue backlog (oldest pending > 48h)' — spec §5 routes the backlog half to dashboard/digest and the liveness half to the CI sweep. Old threshold: oldest pending > 48h over 1d.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-auth-reviews.json widget 8.
-- Gauges: read the LATEST sample per day, not a sum. The 06:00 UTC cron writes one
-- sample per day, so argMax collapses to that sample.
SELECT
    toStartOfDay(m.timestamp) AS day,
    argMaxIf(m.value, m.timestamp, m.metric_name = 'aeci.moderation.queue_depth')             AS queue_depth,
    argMaxIf(m.value, m.timestamp, m.metric_name = 'aeci.moderation.queue_oldest_age_hours')  AS oldest_pending_hours
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 60 DAY
  AND m.metric_name IN ('aeci.moderation.queue_depth', 'aeci.moderation.queue_oldest_age_hours')
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 100

insights.name: AECi — Linear — issue creation by outcome and kind
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Linear issue creation by outcome' + 'by kind', merged. outcome ∈ ok / failed / skipped_exists (an idempotent re-fire); kind ∈ claim / correction.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-requests-moderation.json widgets 1 + 2.
SELECT
    m.attributes.kind    AS kind,
    m.attributes.outcome AS outcome,
    m.attributes.reason  AS failure_reason,
    toInt(sum(m.value))  AS issues
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.linear.issue'
GROUP BY kind, outcome, failure_reason
ORDER BY issues DESC

insights.name: AECi — Linear — pipeline failure rate per hour (%)
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Linear issue creation failure rate (%)' + 'Site→Linear sync' failure rate. Same numerator/denominator as the pipeline alert. The skipped_* outcomes are excluded from the denominator: an idempotent re-fire or a no-issue sync is not a terminal attempt.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-requests-moderation.json widget 3.
SELECT
    toStartOfHour(m.timestamp) AS hour,
    toInt(sum(m.value))        AS terminal_attempts,
    round(100.0 * sumIf(m.value, m.attributes.outcome = 'failed')
          / greatest(sum(m.value), 1), 1) AS failure_rate_pct
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND m.metric_name IN ('aeci.linear.issue', 'aeci.linear.sync')
  AND m.attributes.outcome NOT IN ('skipped_exists', 'skipped_no_issue')
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour DESC
LIMIT 200

insights.name: AECi — Linear — site→Linear sync by outcome and target status
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Site→Linear sync by outcome' + 'by target status', merged. to_status ∈ resolved / rejected.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-requests-moderation.json widgets 5 + 6.
SELECT
    m.attributes.to_status AS to_status,
    m.attributes.kind      AS kind,
    m.attributes.outcome   AS outcome,
    toInt(sum(m.value))    AS syncs
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.linear.sync'
GROUP BY to_status, kind, outcome
ORDER BY syncs DESC

insights.name: AECi — Linear — issue and sync latency
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Linear issue creation latency — p50/p95/p99' + 'Site→Linear sync latency — p50/p95/p99'.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-requests-moderation.json widgets 4 + 7.
WITH per_metric AS (
    SELECT
        m.metric_name                  AS metric,
        sumForEach(m.histogram_counts) AS counts,
        any(m.histogram_bounds)        AS bounds
    FROM posthog.metrics AS m
    WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
      AND m.metric_name IN ('aeci.linear.issue.duration_ms', 'aeci.linear.sync.duration_ms')
    GROUP BY metric
)
SELECT
    metric,
    toInt(arraySum(counts)) AS calls,
    arrayPushBack(bounds, 999999.0)[
        greatest(indexOf(arrayMap(c -> c >= 0.95 * arraySum(counts), arrayCumSum(counts)), 1), 1)
    ] AS p95_bucket_upper_ms
FROM per_metric
ORDER BY metric

insights.name: AECi — Linear — inbound webhook receipts and HMAC failures
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Linear webhook receipts by action' + 'Linear webhook HMAC failures'. HMAC failures also carry an alert (>3/1h) — this is the shape behind that number.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-requests-moderation.json widgets 8 + 9.
SELECT
    toStartOfDay(m.timestamp) AS day,
    m.metric_name             AS metric,
    m.attributes.type         AS resource_type,
    m.attributes.action       AS action,
    toInt(sum(m.value))       AS events
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND m.metric_name IN ('aeci.webhooks.linear.receipt', 'aeci.webhooks.linear.hmac_failure')
GROUP BY day, metric, resource_type, action
ORDER BY day DESC, events DESC
LIMIT 200

insights.name: AECi — Linear — reconciliation backlog, attempts and alert emails
insights.description: Datadog parity: 'Reconciliation backlog — stuck rows (gauge)' + 'Reconciliation attempts by outcome' + 'Reconciliation persistent failures' + 'Admin-alert email seam by outcome'. reconcile.attempt / .persistent_failure submit the ROW COUNT as their value, so they are summed; .stuck is a gauge read with argMax.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/dashboard-requests-moderation.json widgets 10–13.
SELECT
    toStartOfHour(m.timestamp) AS hour,
    argMaxIf(m.value, m.timestamp, m.metric_name = 'aeci.linear.reconcile.stuck')   AS backlog_stuck_rows,
    toInt(sumIf(m.value, m.metric_name = 'aeci.linear.reconcile.attempt'))          AS retry_attempts,
    toInt(sumIf(m.value, m.metric_name = 'aeci.linear.reconcile.persistent_failure')) AS persistent_failures,
    toInt(sumIf(m.value, m.metric_name = 'aeci.linear.reconcile.email'))            AS admin_alert_emails
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND m.metric_name IN (
      'aeci.linear.reconcile.stuck',
      'aeci.linear.reconcile.attempt',
      'aeci.linear.reconcile.persistent_failure',
      'aeci.linear.reconcile.email')
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour DESC
LIMIT 200

insights.name: AECi — Crons — last heartbeat per job (in-product mirror of the CI sweep)
insights.description: NEW. The in-product mirror of scripts/ci/posthog-liveness-sweep.sh. It is a MIRROR, not the mechanism: an insight cannot page on absence, and a check that lives inside the system it watches cannot detect its own death — which is exactly why the sweep runs on GitHub Actions instead. If a job is missing from this table entirely, that IS the absence.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Same twelve heartbeat series as observability/posthog/project-config.json
-- `liveness.crons[].metric`. Keep the two lists in step.
SELECT
    m.metric_name                                        AS heartbeat_metric,
    max(m.timestamp)                                     AS last_seen,
    dateDiff('minute', max(m.timestamp), now())          AS age_minutes,
    toInt(count())                                       AS points_72h
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 72 HOUR
  AND m.metric_name IN (
      'aeci.metrics_snapshot.run',
      'aeci.retention.prune',
      'aeci.data_quality.job',
      'aeci.analytics_digest.email',
      'aeci.moderation.queue_depth',
      'aeci.stats.compute',
      'aeci.algolia.sync',
      'aeci.algolia.index_drift',
      'aeci.attestation.notify.job',
      'aeci.entitlement.expiry.job',
      'aeci.linear.reconcile.stuck',
      'aeci.waf.poll',
      'aeci.asn_registry.refresh')
GROUP BY heartbeat_metric
ORDER BY age_minutes DESC

insights.name: AECi — Crons — failed runs by job (last 7 days)
insights.description: NEW. The breakdown behind the combined 'Cron job failed (any job)' alert: which job, on which day. Four Datadog monitors (Algolia sync / home stats / data quality / retention prune failed) collapsed into that one alert; this is where you find out which of them fired.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Ports the four Datadog *-failed monitors as a breakdown.
SELECT
    toStartOfDay(m.timestamp) AS day,
    m.metric_name             AS job_metric,
    m.attributes.trigger      AS trigger,
    toInt(sum(m.value))       AS failed_runs
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND m.attributes.outcome = 'failed'
  AND m.metric_name IN (
      'aeci.metrics_snapshot.run',
      'aeci.retention.prune',
      'aeci.data_quality.job',
      'aeci.analytics_digest.email',
      'aeci.stats.compute',
      'aeci.stats.compute.key',
      'aeci.algolia.sync',
      'aeci.attestation.notify.job',
      'aeci.entitlement.expiry.job',
      'aeci.waf.poll',
      'aeci.asn_registry.refresh')
GROUP BY day, job_metric, trigger
ORDER BY day DESC, failed_runs DESC

insights.name: AECi — Data quality — findings by check and severity
insights.description: Carries the Datadog monitor 'AECi — Data quality check found WARN-severity issues (by check)', which spec §5 routes to the digest (non-paging). Old threshold: max value by check > 0 over 1d, severity:warn. The ERROR-severity half keeps a real alert. A check that THREW emits the sentinel -1.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Source: observability/datadog/monitor-data-quality-check-warn.json
-- (digest/report-only) + monitor-data-quality-check.json (alerted separately).
SELECT
    toStartOfDay(m.timestamp)    AS day,
    m.attributes.check           AS check_id,
    m.attributes.severity        AS severity,
    argMax(m.value, m.timestamp) AS findings,
    if(argMax(m.value, m.timestamp) < 0, 'CHECK THREW', '') AS note
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.data_quality.check'
GROUP BY day, check_id, severity
ORDER BY day DESC, severity, findings DESC
LIMIT 300

insights.name: AECi — Retention — rows deleted, skipped and truncated runs
insights.description: Carries the Datadog monitor 'AECi — Retention prune skipped (metrics_daily gap)', which spec §5 routes to the digest (non-paging). Old threshold: sum of outcome:skipped > 0 over 1d. `skipped` is the one to watch: a day inside the page_views cut window with no metrics_daily row makes the prune refuse to delete from EITHER table. The runaway threshold (>5,000 rows/table/day) keeps a real alert.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Sources: monitor-retention-prune-skipped.json (digest) +
-- monitor-retention-prune-runaway.json (alerted separately).
SELECT
    toStartOfDay(m.timestamp) AS day,
    m.attributes.table        AS target_table,
    toInt(sumIf(m.value, m.metric_name = 'aeci.retention.rows_deleted'))       AS rows_deleted,
    toInt(sumIf(m.value, m.metric_name = 'aeci.retention.prune.truncated'))    AS truncated_runs,
    toInt(sumIf(m.value, m.metric_name = 'aeci.retention.prune'
                         AND m.attributes.outcome = 'skipped'))                AS skipped_runs,
    arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(toString(m.attributes.reason),
                                       m.attributes.outcome = 'skipped'), ', ') AS skip_reason
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND m.metric_name IN (
      'aeci.retention.rows_deleted',
      'aeci.retention.prune',
      'aeci.retention.prune.truncated')
GROUP BY day, target_table
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 200

insights.name: AECi — ALERT — Worker 5xx rate (1 h)
insights.description: Fires when 5xx responses exceed 1% of Worker-run requests across BOTH Workers in the last hour. Datadog evaluated the same ratio every 5 minutes; hourly is the PostHog floor (spec D3) and is the single largest cadence loss in this migration.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Replaces observability/datadog/monitor-error-rate.json.
-- Denominator floor of 50: at low traffic a single 5xx is >1% and would page on noise.
-- Datadog's 5-minute window had the same exposure; the floor is new and deliberate.
-- `count` is the OTLP histogram observation count — the exact analogue of Datadog's
-- count:<distribution>. Note (§8.2) raw status_code was dropped from the render metric
-- for cardinality; status_class survives and is what this reads.
SELECT
    if(sum(m.count) >= 50,
       round(100.0 * sumIf(m.count, lower(m.attributes.status_class) = '5xx')
             / greatest(sum(m.count), 1), 3),
       0.0)                                                        AS error_rate_pct,
    concat(toString(toInt(sum(m.count))), ' Worker-run requests in 1h; ',
           toString(toInt(sumIf(m.count, lower(m.attributes.status_class) = '5xx'))),
           ' were 5xx')                                            AS sample
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  AND m.metric_name IN ('aeci.page.render.duration_ms', 'aeci.api.query.duration_ms')

insights.name: AECi — ALERT — Cron job failed (any of the twelve, 24 h)
insights.description: COMBINED. One alert covering every scheduled job's failure heartbeat; the breach message names which job(s) via label_column, so combining costs nothing an operator would have used. Replaces four separate Datadog monitors and adds coverage for six crons Datadog never watched.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Replaces FOUR Datadog monitors:
--   monitor-algolia-sync-failed.json, monitor-stats-compute-failed.json,
--   monitor-data-quality-failed.json, monitor-retention-prune-failed.json
-- and ADDS the seven crons Datadog had no failure monitor for: metrics-snapshot,
-- analytics-digest, attestation-notify, entitlement-expiry, waf-poll, asn-registry
-- (which arrived with the AECI-750 reconcile), and the per-key half of home-stats.
--
-- No `trigger:cron` predicate, deliberately: aeci.algolia.sync and aeci.stats.compute
-- also fire on trigger:promote, and a promote-path failure is a real failure. Datadog's
-- Algolia monitor was already trigger-agnostic; its stats monitor was not, and that gap
-- is closed here.
--
-- The aggregate has no GROUP BY, so it ALWAYS returns exactly one row (0 / '') even on
-- a totally empty window. That is the shape a threshold alert needs — a query that can
-- return zero rows has nothing for the alert to evaluate.
SELECT
    sum(m.value)                                                   AS failed_runs,
    arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(m.metric_name), ', ')         AS failing_jobs
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND m.attributes.outcome = 'failed'
  AND m.metric_name IN (
      'aeci.metrics_snapshot.run',
      'aeci.retention.prune',
      'aeci.data_quality.job',
      'aeci.analytics_digest.email',
      'aeci.stats.compute',
      'aeci.stats.compute.key',
      'aeci.algolia.sync',
      'aeci.attestation.notify.job',
      'aeci.entitlement.expiry.job',
      'aeci.waf.poll',
      'aeci.asn_registry.refresh')

insights.name: AECi — ALERT — Data quality ERROR-severity findings (24 h)
insights.description: Fires when any error-severity data-quality check reports a non-zero finding count OR throws. Distinct from the cron-failure alert: the job succeeded, the DATA is wrong. Different runbook, so it keeps its own alert.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Replaces observability/datadog/monitor-data-quality-check.json.
-- abs(), not max(): a check that THREW emits the sentinel -1, and Datadog's
-- `max:... by {check} > 0` could not see that — a thrown error-severity check was
-- silently indistinguishable from a clean one. Taking abs() closes that hole.
SELECT
    max(abs(m.value))                                                              AS worst_finding,
    arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(toString(m.attributes.check), m.value != 0), ', ') AS failing_checks
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.data_quality.check'
  AND m.attributes.severity = 'error'

insights.name: AECi — ALERT — Retention prune deleted an unexpected number of rows (24 h)
insights.description: The destructive-job safety valve. Kept as its own alert rather than folded into the combined cron-failure alert: a runaway prune is a SUCCESSFUL run with the wrong effect, and its runbook is 'check what was deleted before it ages out', not 'restart the job'.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Replaces observability/datadog/monitor-retention-prune-runaway.json.
-- aeci.retention.rows_deleted is emitted every run for every table, zeros included,
-- which is what makes a threshold (rather than a presence) test possible at all.
SELECT
    max(rows_deleted)                                                           AS max_rows_deleted,
    arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(tbl, rows_deleted > 5000), ', ')         AS tables_over_budget
FROM (
    SELECT
        toString(m.attributes.table) AS tbl,
        sum(m.value)                 AS rows_deleted
    FROM posthog.metrics AS m
    WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
      AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.retention.rows_deleted'
    GROUP BY tbl
)

insights.name: AECi — ALERT — Linear reconciliation persistent failures (1 h)
insights.description: A user-visible vendor request whose Linear issue creation has failed repeatedly. Kept separate from the combined cron alert: the sweep itself is healthy, a REQUEST is stuck, and the operator action is to look at that request.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Replaces observability/datadog/monitor-linear-reconcile-stuck.json.
-- The metric submits the ROW COUNT as its value, not 1 — so it is summed, not counted.
SELECT
    sum(m.value)                                          AS persistent_failures,
    'vendor_requests stuck open with linear_issue_id=null after a retry' AS detail
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.linear.reconcile.persistent_failure'

insights.name: AECi — ALERT — Algolia orphan sweep hit its safety cap (24 h)
insights.description: The delete-only orphan sweep refused a large purge. Kept separate from the combined cron alert because the JOB SUCCEEDED — folding a success-with-a-caveat into 'job failed' would make that alert's meaning mushy.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Replaces observability/datadog/monitor-algolia-orphan-sweep-capped.json.
-- Emitted only when the cap actually refuses a purge, so a healthy window has no rows —
-- which is why this reads through a subquery aggregate that still yields one row.
SELECT
    max(skipped)                                                        AS max_skipped,
    arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(idx, skipped > 0), ', ')         AS capped_indexes
FROM (
    SELECT
        toString(m.attributes.index) AS idx,
        max(m.value)                 AS skipped
    FROM posthog.metrics AS m
    WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
      AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.algolia.orphans_skipped_cap'
    GROUP BY idx
)

insights.name: AECi — ALERT — Auth sign-in failure rate (1 h)
insights.description: Datadog evaluated this over 15 minutes; hourly is the PostHog floor. Threshold unchanged at 30%. A minimum-denominator floor of 5 attempts is NEW — at AECi's sign-in volume a 1-of-2 failure is 50% and would have paged.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Replaces observability/datadog/monitor-auth-error-rate.json.
-- Emitted from the SSR Worker at /auth/callback, so these points carry service=aeci-web.
SELECT
    if(sum(m.value) >= 5,
       round(100.0 * sumIf(m.value, m.attributes.outcome = 'failed')
             / greatest(sum(m.value), 1), 1),
       0.0)                                                          AS failure_rate_pct,
    concat(toString(toInt(sum(m.value))), ' sign-in completions in 1h') AS sample
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.auth.signin'

insights.name: AECi — ALERT — Toxicity scoring failure rate (1 h)
insights.description: Datadog evaluated over 15 minutes; hourly is the PostHog floor. Threshold unchanged at 50%. Minimum-denominator floor of 5 is new.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Replaces observability/datadog/monitor-toxicity-outage.json.
-- Backed by Claude Haiku since AECI-258 (Perspective API sunset) —
-- apps/api/src/lib/toxicity.ts.
SELECT
    if(sum(m.value) >= 5,
       round(100.0 * sumIf(m.value, m.attributes.outcome = 'failed')
             / greatest(sum(m.value), 1), 1),
       0.0)                                                        AS failure_rate_pct,
    concat(toString(toInt(sum(m.value))), ' scoring calls in 1h; reasons: ',
           arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(toString(m.attributes.reason),
                                              m.attributes.outcome = 'failed'), '/')) AS sample
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.toxicity.api'

insights.name: AECi — ALERT — page_views write failure rate (1 h)
insights.description: Datadog evaluated over 10 minutes; hourly is the PostHog floor. Threshold unchanged at 10%. Minimum-denominator floor of 20 is new — page_views is the highest-volume write in the system, so 20/hour is a low bar that still suppresses the 3-request-hour false positive.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Replaces observability/datadog/monitor-pageviews-write-errors.json.
-- ADR 0022: page_views is a derived/log-class write and is exempt from audit_log — this
-- metric plus job_runs IS its observability.
SELECT
    if(sum(m.value) >= 20,
       round(100.0 * sumIf(m.value, m.attributes.outcome = 'failed')
             / greatest(sum(m.value), 1), 2),
       0.0)                                                        AS error_rate_pct,
    concat(toString(toInt(sum(m.value))), ' page-view writes in 1h') AS sample
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.pageviews.write'

insights.name: AECi — ALERT — Linear pipeline failure rate (1 h)
insights.description: Window unchanged at 1 h (Datadog already used last_1h); only the evaluation cadence moves to hourly. Threshold unchanged at 50%. Minimum-denominator floor of 3 is new.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Replaces observability/datadog/monitor-linear-pipeline-failure.json.
-- The skipped_* outcomes are excluded from the denominator, exactly as Datadog did:
-- an idempotent re-fire (skipped_exists) or a no-issue sync (skipped_no_issue) is not a
-- terminal attempt and counting it would dilute a real outage into invisibility.
SELECT
    if(sum(m.value) >= 3,
       round(100.0 * sumIf(m.value, m.attributes.outcome = 'failed')
             / greatest(sum(m.value), 1), 1),
       0.0)                                                        AS failure_rate_pct,
    concat(toString(toInt(sum(m.value))), ' terminal pipeline attempts in 1h') AS sample
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  AND m.metric_name IN ('aeci.linear.issue', 'aeci.linear.sync')
  AND m.attributes.outcome NOT IN ('skipped_exists', 'skipped_no_issue')

insights.name: AECi — ALERT — Linear webhook HMAC failures (1 h)
insights.description: Security signal, unchanged in every respect: same 1 h window, same threshold of 3, only the evaluation cadence moves to hourly.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Replaces observability/datadog/monitor-webhook-hmac-failure.json.
-- Emitted BEFORE the 401 when Linear-Signature is missing or invalid. A sustained
-- non-zero series is either a rotated webhook secret or someone probing the endpoint.
SELECT
    sum(m.value)                                              AS hmac_failures,
    'POST /api/webhooks/linear rejected before handling'      AS detail
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.webhooks.linear.hmac_failure'

insights.name: AECi — ALERT — WAF rate-limit / challenge volume (1 h)
insights.description: THRESHOLD RESCALED, deliberately: Datadog fired on >500 blocked events in 15 minutes; the equivalent hourly rate is 500 x 4 = 2,000. The underlying data is unchanged — the source is an HOURLY cron reading the previous clock hour from Cloudflare's GraphQL API, so Datadog's 15-minute window was always coarser than it looked.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Replaces observability/datadog/monitor-waf-ratelimit-spike.json.
-- aeci.waf.ratelimit.blocked submits the EVENT COUNT as its value, not 1 — summed.
-- Scoped to this env's own host by the poll itself, so a shared zone is not counted
-- under every env tag.
SELECT
    sum(m.value)                                                                     AS blocked_events,
    concat('top rules: ',
           arrayStringConcat(arraySlice(arraySort(groupUniqArray(toString(m.attributes.rule))), 1, 5), ', ')) AS sample
FROM posthog.metrics AS m
WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.waf.ratelimit.blocked'

insights.name: AECi — ALERT — Detail page render p95, cache MISS (1 h)
insights.description: PORTED with a caveat — read the query comments. PostHog stores our distributions as OTLP explicit-bucket histograms, so there is no percentile function: this p95 is the UPPER BOUND of the bucket the 95th observation falls in. Conservative by at most one bucket width (the right direction for an alert) but UNVERIFIED UNTIL DATA FLOWS — README.md manual step 2.
insights.query:
-- AECI-647 / PH-6. Replaces observability/datadog/monitor-detail-render-p95.json.
--
-- Bucket bounds are pinned by the transport (spec §2):
--   [5,10,25,50,75,100,250,500,750,1000,1500,2500,5000,7500,10000] ms
-- and histogram_counts carries bounds.length + 1 entries — the extra one is the +Inf
-- overflow bucket. `arrayPushBack(bounds, 999999.0)` gives that overflow bucket an edge:
-- without it a p95 above 10 s indexes past the end of `bounds`, ClickHouse returns the
-- 0 default, and the WORST case would silently fail to fire.
--
-- sumForEach() sums the count arrays element-wise across every data point. It is only
-- correct because every point shares one bound array; if a future metric ships different
-- bounds under the same name the arrays misalign silently. Do not reuse this shape
-- without re-checking that.
--
-- lower(cache_status): the SSR Worker emits the literal 'MISS' (server-runtime.ts:989).
-- Datadog lowercased tag values on ingest and PostHog does not, so a copied
-- `cache_status:miss` predicate would match nothing. See README.md §'Migration hazards'.
--
-- Under WC-8 a cache HIT skips the Worker entirely, so this series is MISS-only volume
-- and can be sparse. The 20-observation floor keeps a quiet hour from producing a p95
-- out of three samples.
WITH agg AS (
    SELECT
        sumForEach(m.histogram_counts) AS counts,
        any(m.histogram_bounds)        AS bounds
    FROM posthog.metrics AS m
    WHERE m.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
      AND m.metric_name = 'aeci.page.render.duration_ms'
      AND m.attributes.route_class = 'detail'
      AND lower(m.attributes.cache_status) = 'miss'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        arraySum(counts)                AS observations,
        arrayPushBack(bounds, 999999.0) AS edges,
        indexOf(arrayMap(c -> c >= 0.95 * arraySum(counts), arrayCumSum(counts)), 1) AS bucket_index
    FROM agg
)
SELECT
    if(observations < 20 OR bucket_index = 0, 0.0, edges[bucket_index]) AS p95_bucket_upper_ms,
    concat(toString(toInt(observations)), ' MISS detail renders in 1h') AS sample
FROM ranked
